content: Supabase SSR auth in Next.js App Router uses @supabase/ssr's createServerClient/createBrowserClient. Because Server Components cannot write cookies, a proxy.ts (Next.js 16's renamed middleware.ts) must call supabase.auth.getUser() on every request to refresh expired tokens and propagate updated Set-Cookie headers to the browser -- if the proxy refreshes the token but fails to forward the new cookies, the user silently stays logged out. Use getUser() (revalidates against Auth server) not getSession() for authorization decisions.
